newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Explorers Index soars in week.
newsitem.headline: Australian Explorers Index soars in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index soared 199.1 points or 6.7 percent last week. The All Ordinaries index eased 0.16 percent.
Nov 22 Nov 15 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The sharp rise in the index was stimulated by exploration encouragement from the Gawler Craton region of South Australia, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary.
"Speculative interest rapidly spread through the small resource sector, gains outnumbering falls two to one," he said.
Helix Resources NL took centre stage after releasing drill results from its Lake Everard prospect in the Gawler Craton, more than tripling its share price bo A$1.70.
Among tenement neighbours, Equinox Resources NL jumped 20 cents to 58 cents and Goldstream Mining NL leaped 15 cents to 44.5 cents.
Gawler Craton fever swept through all juniors that held ground in the region, Colgan said.
Other good gainers included Alkane Exploration NL, which rose 10.5 cents to 39 cents. Alkane produces gold at Peak Hill in New South Wales.
Consolidated Gold NL rose 10.5 cents to 55 after deep drill hits at is Davyhurst deposits in Western Australia.
Falls included Coolgardie Gold NL, which slid 2.5 cents to 12.5, Strategic Minerals Corp NL, down one to eight cents, and Victoria Petroleum NL which eased 0.4 to 4.3 cents.
